answer: Sybil resistance comes from an economic bond: each agent locks capital as collateral before its vote counts. A shared atlas of attestations records which identities vouch for one another, so a fake legion cannot manufacture trust from nothing. Caught fraud slashes the bond, turning a violet pigment forgery ring into a real loss: to sway a decision an attacker must outspend the honest stake behind each edge. The cost scales with committed capital, not with how cheaply wallets are minted.
